Overview

Float under the Arctic stars—or even the Northern Lights—with warm drinks, cookies, and unmatched serenity on our cozy Ice Floating Tour.

What's included?

Pick-up/drop-off in central Rovaniemi
Beautiful location on a frozen lake

What to expect?

Immerse yourself in the magic of the Arctic with our Ice Floating Tour, where you’ll drift in a frozen lake, cozy in our thermal wetsuits, beneath the vast Lappish sky. With the chance to float under a starlit sky—or, if conditions allow, beneath the dazzling Northern Lights—you’ll also enjoy warm drinks and cookies, adding a touch of comfort to this unforgettable winter adventure.

Our floating suits are universal sizes so please make sure you fit into this measurements:"

	Day 6	Activity		01/11/2026					Tromso	"Tromsø: Northern Lights Chase by Coach with Pro Photos Included | 18:00 | 7 Hrs | Pick up / meeting point
Tromsø Havn Prostneset Terminal, Samuel Arnesens gate 5

Overview

Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey with us, chasing the magic in the Arctic skies from the heart of Tromsø. We will be chasing low light pollution and trying to dodge those pesky clouds that might try to steal the show of the aurora borealis from us.

What's included?

Pick-up/drop-off in central Tromsø
Knowledgeable, English-speaking guide
Premium coach with toilet facilities
Professional photos from your trip
Hot drink and biscuits are provided

What to expect?

Our mission is to take you on a thrilling ride searching the celestial canvas above. We will be heading to the prime spots with the highest odds of catching the mesmerising auroras.

Once we have found the perfect spot, where the stage is set for nature's grand performance, we'll warm your soul with steaming hot drinks and biscuits. Our dedicated guides will be your Arctic companions throughout the evening, ensuring you're nice and cozy. Since Tromsø's weather likes to keep us guessing, we might just turn this adventure into a dance with the elements, taking you to various awe-inspiring locations under the Arctic night sky in search of our lady in the sky.

If we’re blessed by the Northern Lights gracing us with their presence, our guides will capture those magical moments with some stunning portrait photos. Consider it your cosmic photo op, capturing memories that will last a lifetime.

So, get ready to chase the auroras like never before, with us by your side every step of the way."
	Day 7	Activity		02/11/2026					Tromso	"Tromsø: Photo Tour to Arctic Landscapes and Fjords | 11 AM | 5 Hrs | 

Overview

Join a photo excursion to some of the most scenic areas outside of Tromsø. Depending on the weather, we might for example choose to drive to Sommaroy, also known as 'Summer Island'. This is a scenic route through valleys and fjords, alonside the sea and past lakes. White sandy beaches and iconic bridges.

What's included?

Departure from Tromsø. Drop-off to your hotel
Professional, English-speaking photo guides
Scenic fjord safari by minivan vehicle
Help with camera settings and nature photos
Small-group experience with 4-8 guests
Soup or expedition food
Coffee and waffles/cookies

What to expect?

This is a road trip that you will forever remember. We might even encounter reindeers as they often wander around this area. Depending on the time of the year, this trip can become a true safari through Tromso`s Arctic pearls.

IMPORTANT INFO:

Meeting time: 15 min. before departure. Bring warm clothes, even in summer.

This tour requires a minimum of 4 people. If we do not reach the minimum amount of people, we will team up with one of our partners that runs a similar tour.

	Day 10	Activity		05/11/2026					Oslo	" Oslo : Essential Oslo, City Center Guided Walking Tour | 10 AM | 2 Hrs | 

Experience the beauty of the Norwegian capital on foot with this walking tour
See all the major sights and attractions in a pedestrian part of Oslo
Save money with this great value pass

Meet our guide near the University of Oslo,

Start your day with a guided walking tour of Oslo's most popular sights and landmarks.

*From 17 November to 30 December, the Christmas Walk will replace the Essential Oslo Tour.

Explore the major attractions of the vibrant Norwegian capital on our bestselling city tour. Meet our guide near the University of Oslo, in the city’s heart, and embark on a thrilling urban adventure! First, you will visit the modern Oslo Opera House, which quickly became the city’s icon after its construction in 2008. Our guide will tell you about this building and the radical transformation of the neighborhood, which occurred during the last two decades.

Next, you will stroll down Karl Johans gate, the city’s emblematic two-lane central street. That’s where you can truly appreciate Oslo's stunning 19th-century architecture. We will make the first stop on this street near Domkirke, or as the locals gently call this cathedral—the “Dom.” The city’s main church was built in the late 17th century and substantially reconstructed during the 19th century.

Follow our guide’s lead and see the other prominent buildings on Oslo’s main street. Stortinget, the Parliament building, was erected during the second part of the 19th century when Norway was in a forced union with Sweden. You will also notice the Grand Hotel building nearby—renowned playwright Henrik Ibsen used to frequent its café. A statue dedicated to Ibsen stands in front of the neighboring National Theater, not far from another one that depicts Bjørnstjerne Bjørnson.

The majestic Royal Palace of Oslo stands on a hill at the end of the street. Even though it was built for the very person this street is named after, Karl Johan has never got a chance to reside in this magnificent palace. Our tour guide will delve deeper into the story of the French general-turned-Swedish king and how he became the ruler of Norway.

Before the tour concludes, you will visit one more iconic building—the red-brick Oslo City Hall. Its construction took decades to finish, but today, this place embodies the spirit of Oslo (and Norway in general)—the walls of this building are painted with numerous frescoes depicting the history of this Scandinavian country.

Join our walking tour today to explore Oslo in a fun and exciting way! "
